min-width.$description: Minimum width of the wheel — a row wider than this widens it.

option-height.$description: Height of a row — and, times the count of rows shown, of the wheel.

option-height-sm.$description: Height of a row, small size.

option-height-lg.$description: Height of a row, large size.

option-font-size-sm.$description: Text size of a row, small size.

option-font-size-lg.$description: Text size of a row, large size.

option-fg-selected.$description: Text colour of the chosen row, which rests in the band.

option-font-weight-selected.$description: Text weight of the chosen row.

option-fg-disabled.$description: Text colour of a row the line never rests on, and of every row of a disabled wheel.

band-bg.$description: Background of the band — the line the middle row rests under.

band-border-invalid.$description: Edge colour of the band when invalid.

edge-alpha.$description: How much of a row's colour is left at the two edges of the wheel; the rows fade to it from the band outwards.

fg-invalid.$description: Text colour of the error message and the required sign.

fg-warning.$description: Text colour of the warning line (0087); the band keeps its edge, a warning being no fault of the control.
